sql: SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT (T2.MSRP - T1.priceEach) / T2.MSRP FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T1.productCode = 'S18_3482' AND T1.orderNumber = 10108

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.customerNumber) AS REAL) / 12 FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.productCode = T3.productCode WHERE T3.productName = '1957 Chevy Pickup'
